cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(native_fixture C)
if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Native target is marked as cross-compiling")
endif()
try_run(run_result compile_result "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/try" SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.c")
if(NOT compile_result OR NOT run_result STREQUAL "0")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Native try_run failed: ${compile_result}, ${run_result}")
endif()
